unchangedRules: Original baseline evidence, contract command definitions, environment checks and npm test script remain unchanged.
Every existing frozen assertion and harness file remains present.
All required semantic checks execute, with zero failures, cancellations, skips or TODOs, and no reduced TAP test totals.
Changing an existing assertion or harness file requires externally pinned exact old/new SHA-256 values, a substantive reason and original-scenario/evidence mappings.
New assertion files are additive. New harness helpers require explicit null-old-hash entries and exact new hashes.

Literal relative script helpers outside the original assertion roots require explicit assertion entries with null old hash and exact new hash. Import discovery never executes the helper; omitted, changed, missing or unreferenced extra helpers block verification. The helper is copied into candidate assertion evidence and checked again after execution.
Missing, unused, duplicate, unreviewed, stale-hash or incorrectly baseline-bound declarations block verification.
A declaration documents reviewed changes; it does not establish behavioral equivalence without passing the preserved checks.
reviewSequence: Wait until candidate assertions, browser smokes and verifier helper source are final; generate a new draft in a nonexistent output file.

Review each complete original-to-candidate diff, including all helper bytes. Preserve behavioral, durability, authorization and conflict expectations; document intentional implementation-shape changes.

Fill each entry's reason, original P01-P12 scenarioIds and exact evidence/test mappings, including extracted helpers such as scripts/collaboration-smoke-transport.mjs. The generator leaves these fields empty and status draft. Computed import expressions require manual dependency review; literal-import discovery is not a whole-program proof.

Set status reviewed only after that explicit review, preserve the original baseline and independently pin the completed declaration's SHA-256 in the verification invocation or trusted integration configuration.
Run the original verification contract with --delta FILE --delta-sha256 DIGEST. Any later assertion/helper edit requires new review and a new independently pinned declaration digest.
Inspect the report/manifest's complete contractDelta declaration and exact applied changes together with command logs; a drafted declaration or blocked run is not maturity evidence.
note: No candidate changes are approved or frozen by this policy file. Candidate browser smokes are still under development.
